text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A after a gain, which felt satisfying, but I should base future trades on risk and prospects rather than the comfort of locking in a profit.","I held through substantial account declines; because past price changes do not predict future ones, I should review whether my holdings remain appropriate instead of reacting to recent losses.","I rarely trade, which can help avoid impulsive decisions, but I should still monitor diversification and risk regularly rather than letting inaction become automatic."]}
